## What you should be able to do tonight

- State the profit of a continuously delta-hedged short option as a function of implied and realized variance.
- Confirm your simulation matches that prediction across a range of volatility gaps.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>60 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Derive the relationship: the instantaneous profit of a delta-hedged short option is proportional to gamma times the difference between implied variance and the squared realized move, integrated over the life of the option. Write it out, then note that gamma weights the contribution by where the path spent its time.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Test the prediction: run the simulation at implied minus realized volatility gaps from minus 10 to plus 10 points and plot mean profit against the gap. Overlay the closed-form prediction. Where the simulation deviates, the cause is that the path-dependent gamma weighting is not captured by the simple version, which is itself the point of the next day.
:::
:::
